display.purpose: One serif display title per view; 26px, bold, tight tracking.

title.purpose: Serif chart-card and section titles; steps 17px to 20px at 640px.

body.purpose: Public Sans working prose and controls; tabular numerals globally; 65ch prose cap.

label.purpose: The mono uppercase wire-ticker voice: section labels, table headers, badges, chart notes. 11px is the floor of the whole type system.

shadows.name: elevation-card
shadows.purpose: Resting cards; a hairline, not a lift.

shadows.name: elevation-card-hover
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, black 35%, transparent), 0 8px 24px color-mix(in oklab, black 22%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Hovered cards; the one soft lift in the system.

shadows.name: elevation-sticky
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, black 30%, transparent), 0 4px 14px color-mix(in oklab, black 22%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Sticky headers and the filter rail.

shadows.name: elevation-modal
shadows.value: 0 8px 16px color-mix(in oklab, black 36%, transparent), 0 32px 64px color-mix(in oklab, black 44%, transparent)

shadows.name: elevation-drawer
shadows.value: 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklab, black 30%, transparent), 8px 0 32px color-mix(in oklab, black 30%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Left-edge drawer; shadow falls right onto the covered page.

shadows.name: elevation-drawer-mirrored
shadows.value: -1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklab, black 30%, transparent), -8px 0 32px color-mix(in oklab, black 30%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Right-edge drawer; mirror of the above — edit them together.

shadows.name: ring-focus
shadows.purpose: Wire Amber focus ring on every focusable control.

motion.name: ease-default
motion.purpose: Out-expo; the house easing for state changes.

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: The mono uppercase wire-ticker label that names every section, table column, and chart caveat.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 64%, transparent); }

components.name: Select
components.description: The standard dropdown: quiet tonal fill, square-ish corner, Wire Amber focus ring.
components.css: .ds-select { font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(0.97 0.005 260); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 4%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 13%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-select:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 20%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 6%, transparent); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.78 0.13 80); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.78 0.13 80) 38%, transparent); }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Hairline-radius filter chips; a selected chip is painted entirely by its sentiment value's fg/bg/border triple.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; border-radius: 1px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 6%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 13%, transparent); color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 84%, transparent); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-chip:hover:not([data-tone]) { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(0.97 0.005 260); } .ds-chip[data-tone='positive'] { color: oklch(0.7 0.13 150); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.7 0.13 150) 16%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.7 0.13 150) 32%, transparent); } .ds-chip[data-tone='very-negative'] { color: oklch(0.62 0.2 25); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.62 0.2 25) 18%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.62 0.2 25) 36%, transparent); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation entry; the active state is a 14% Wire Amber tonal fill with the 3px accent rail.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 220px; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 64%, transparent); font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(0.97 0.005 260); } .ds-nav-item[data-state='active'] { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.78 0.13 80) 14%, transparent); color: oklch(0.97 0.005 260); } .ds-nav-item[data-state='active']::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 20%; bottom: 20%; width: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.82 0.12 80); } .ds-nav-item[data-state='active'] svg { color: oklch(0.86 0.1 80); }

components.name: Chart Card
components.description: The opaque editorial panel every chart lives in: eyebrow + serif title header over a hairline, dashed-rule methodology note underneath.
components.html:
Polarité

Répartition des sentiments

Les valeurs « Non applicable » sont exclues de la moyenne mais comptées dans le total.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 360px; background: oklch(0.205 0.012 260); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 8%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, black 35%, transparent); overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 20%, transparent); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 8%, transparent); } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 64%, transparent); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.008em; color: oklch(0.97 0.005 260); margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { padding: 40px 20px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 46%, transparent); text-align: center; } .ds-card-note { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1.7; color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 64%, transparent); margin: 0 20px 16px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 8%, transparent); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The wire-service table idiom: sticky mono uppercase headers on an opaque elevated fill, hairline row separators, tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; max-width: 420px; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: oklch(0.205 0.012 260); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 8%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-table th { padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; background: oklch(0.235 0.015 260); color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 64%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 8%, transparent); } .ds-table td { padding: 12px 16px; color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 84%, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 8%, transparent); } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 4%, transparent); }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: Chart-type switcher: a nested track holding mono uppercase buttons; the active one speaks Wire Amber.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; gap: 1px; padding: 2px; background: oklch(0.175 0.011 260); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 8%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-toggle-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.97 0.005 260) 64%, transparent); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 1px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-toggle-btn:hover:not([data-active='true']) { color: oklch(0.97 0.005 260); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.99 0 0) 10%, transparent); } .ds-toggle-btn[data-active='true'] { color: oklch(0.78 0.13 80); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.78 0.13 80) 14%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: A wire service's overnight desk: matte dark surfaces under low light, dispatches arriving as data, everything read against everything else before morning. The interface is investigative · rigorous · contemporary — a piece of data journalism that happens to be interactive, never a SaaS product, never a museum exhibit. Charts are the primary content; every piece of chrome earns its weight against the chart it surrounds. The desk's materials are matte and opaque: solid ink-dark panels, square corners, hairline borders, no glass and no glow. Its voice is typographic — a serif byline face for titles, a working sans for prose, and the monospace eyebrow that runs through the whole interface like a ticker. Colour belongs to the data; the interface itself speaks in one warm amber, sparingly.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, dense, editorial; charts foregrounded, chrome restrained
Opaque matte surfaces, square corners, hairline borders — no glassmorphism
Serif display / sans body / mono eyebrow three-voice typography
Sentiment carried by perceptually-uniform OKLCH ramps, never by hue alone
Methodology visible, uncertainty named in words

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Wire Amber is the interface's ink; the sentiment ramps are the data's ink. The accent never fills a chart, and a data colour never decorates chrome. If amber appears inside a plot, something is wrong.

rules.name: The Equal-Lightness Rule
rules.body: The polarity poles sit at equal OKLCH lightness so a 'Très négatif' bar reads no brighter than a 'Très positif' bar at equal area. Red and green therefore differ only in hue — which is why sentiment is never carried by hue alone.

rules.name: The Chart Hex Rule
rules.body: ECharts and MapLibre cannot parse oklch(), color-mix() or CSS variables. Chart-facing colour is duplicated as hex in chartTheme.ts, each value annotated with the oklch() it mirrors, and chartTheme.palette.test.ts fails the build if the copies drift.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The 11px mono uppercase eyebrow is the smallest type in the app and the floor — nothing goes below it. If content does not fit, the control needs less content, not smaller text.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular everywhere data appears, and numbers are localised per language. A proportional numeral in a stat column is a defect.

rules.name: The Container Rule
rules.body: A component inside the 320px filter rail never branches on viewport width — it asks its container (@container filter-rail). In JavaScript, MediaQuery from svelte/reactivity, never a one-shot window.innerWidth read.

rules.name: The Mirrored Drawer Rule
rules.body: A drawer's shadow falls onto the page it covers, so a right-edge drawer casts left. The two drawer tokens are mirror images differing only in the sign of the x-offset — edit them together.

rules.name: The One Resolver Rule
rules.body: No component maps a sentiment value to a colour itself — ever. Emit the data attribute; read --sentiment-fg/-bg/-border.

dos: Do reach for semantic tokens first (--pad-card, --gap-stack, --font-size-eyebrow); numbered primitives are for one-off nudges.
Do label sections, tables and captions in the mono eyebrow voice — it is the system's signature.
Do keep every surface opaque and every border a 1px hairline.
Do name sentiment in words and shapes alongside colour, and keep tooltips glyph-marked.
Do guard all motion behind prefers-reduced-motion, including scroll behaviour.
Do keep French and English layouts equal — copy must survive ~30% expansion without breaking.
donts: Don't use SaaS tells: gradient pill buttons, rainbow icon backgrounds, purple→blue gradients, marketing hero panels, identical elevate-everything card grids, emoji in chrome.
Don't use glassmorphism — no backdrop-filter, no translucent panels, no inset highlights.
Don't put Wire Amber in a chart or a sentiment colour in chrome (the Two Inks Rule).
Don't invent radii, breakpoints, or font sizes outside the declared vocabularies.
Don't ship a light theme; color-scheme is dark and the palettes assume it.
Don't let a component ask the viewport what its container knows (the Container Rule).
